verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rule or automation engine in Lago that fires actions when events occur. Webhooks (lago-docs-7, lago-docs-21) are outbound callbacks a developer could build automation on, which is a building block rather than the capability. Automatic invoice generation per plan and the Dunning Agent are fixed built-in behaviours, not rules the user configures.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
